scenario_description:
Objective: Preserve an optional shared-load alternative for HM-22's routine return without disturbing its confirmed dedicated transport.
Emerging Need: A compatible coastal run gains one sealed compartment while packing readiness and the lender's receiving flexibility become known through separate channels.
Decision Context: The packing slot, dock window, capacity deadline, and case-specific authorization determine when a reversible hold and comparison quote are appropriate; any carrier change still requires director approval.
Consequence: Timely coordination could provide measurable cost and emissions benefits while retaining the original booking; ignoring the opening leaves the normal return fully intact but yields no comparison option.

parameter.title: HM-22 return packing
parameter.description: Provisional deinstallation and crate-sealing slot pending production lock.

parameter.subject: Open sealed bay on November 13 coastal run
parameter.body: Northstar has one museum-grade sealed compartment open on our November 13 coastal shared-load run. It would reach the HM-22 lender dock between 9:00 a.m. and noon. Comparison quote requests close Friday, November 7 at 3:00 p.m.; a no-fee courtesy hold can then remain in place until Monday, November 9 at noon. Your dedicated November 14 booking is unchanged.

parameter.content: The packing crew cleared its equipment conflict. If production locks the current November 12 slot, HM-22 can be sealed and released from the receiving room by 10:00 a.m.; the later end time is only contingency margin.

parameter.subject: HM-22 receiving windows next week
parameter.body: Our lender dock can receive HM-22 on November 13 between 9:00 a.m. and noon. A shared-load arrival is acceptable if the object remains in a separately sealed museum-grade compartment. The existing November 14 dedicated delivery window also remains available.

parameter.title: HM-22 return packing
parameter.description: Production lock issued; crew will complete crate sealing and release by 10:00 a.m.

parameter.subject: November 13 sealed bay allocated
parameter.body: The unheld sealed compartment on the November 13 coastal run has now been allocated. Northstar can no longer prepare a comparison quote or place a capacity hold for that run. Your dedicated November 14 booking remains confirmed.

parameters: For MOV-HM22-OUT only, after a confirmed museum packing slot ending no later than 10:00 a.m. on November 12 and lender acceptance of a November 13 receiving window are both documented, Mireya may request one no-obligation comparison quote and place one no-fee revocable capacity hold with Northstar Fine Art Transit through Soren Bell at sbell@northstarfineart.example. The request must cite MOV-HM22-OUT and ask for a separately sealed museum-grade compartment plus cost and emissions comparisons. The existing dedicated November 14 booking must remain active; changing carriers or transport plans still requires collections director approval.
